message.content: Based on the discussion, Dyllan describes the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" as diverse and challenging. He appreciates the varied environments that bring different challenges and finds the combat itself to be engaging, though it can be tricky, especially when dealing with flying machines. Dyllan mentions handling these aerial threats by sticking to a bow with elemental arrows, using the Control Center's audio settings, and employing traps effectively. This shows that Dyllan values the flexibility and strategy provided by the Control Center to manage combat encounters.
